notes: Rameez sent an Instagram reel I could not open (login wall) and said 'perhaps show nixwoods light doing this to mugs'. Built on one stated assumption: the shelf's inset LED is a RAKING light at the front edge, so a row of mugs is the ideal subject — each catches a bright warm edge and throws a long shadow back onto the wall. Shots 1 and 2 are the SAME still, the first pushed down with a per-shot grade and the second at full level: a grade-driven reveal, not a filmed switch-on — nothing in the source footage shows the light being turned on, and the caption must not claim it does. Real workshop footage carries the middle (track, polish, three) so the reel is not purely rendered. Hook scores 9/12, all three gates — the best in this product's set. THREE of eight shots are AI-generated stills: paid use needs Meta's AI disclosure, and the caption says the room shots are renders.
name: M1-shelf-mugs
